policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: The combined rebased #128 and #176/#538/#550 client changes extend modal-history ownership, private navigation suppression, nested-modal accessibility, and navigation-ledger coverage in the instrumented client/core scope. Three clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-08-02 each passed all 2,011 tests across 243 files with zero unhandled errors and reproduced exactly 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). Relative to the reviewed #128 main baseline of 2,738/3,128 (87.532%), the combined tree adds 73 instrumented lines and 70 covered lines while increasing coverage percentage. The exact observed envelope needs no instrumentation tolerance, so the new floor is 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, observed-high-water, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The independently reviewed combined #590/#594 tree retains the bounded redacted action-audit authority and adds the shared Hidden Content installed-item owner for accessible Movie/Series/Episode configuration. The Hidden Content scope includes authoritative actor/item projections, native exact-scope replacement/removal with revision preconditions, exact legacy home-surface merge/delete/TMDB/episode/poster parity, an opaque-data-free bounded action-result projection below the 64 KiB idempotency ceiling, durable forward-compatible extension preservation, deterministic linear first-wins alias merging with early aggregate bounds, full-graph validation, capacity and corruption fail-closed behavior, cache invalidation, strict access-boundary construction guards, and isolated orphan repair. The owner measures 93.880% line coverage, its result projections, mutation-evidence and legacy-row helpers 100%, the Platform adapter 96.960%, and shared defaults 100%. Four clean Coverlet runs on the identical rebased 2026-08-03 source and 42,567-line scope each passed all 2,942 server tests: three measured 33,569 covered lines and one measured 33,570. Relative to the reviewed #590 main high-water of 33,118/41,847 (79.141%), #594 adds 720 reviewed instrumented lines and raises the observed high-water by 452 covered lines to 33,570/42,567 (78.864%). The exact one-line 33,569-33,570 local instrumentation envelope therefore sets a 33,570 high-water with a one-line tolerance and a floor of 33,569/42,567 (78.862%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, observed-high-water, spread, single-run, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
